citation.authors: Al-Dabagh A, Davis SA, McMichael AJ, Feldman SR

cited_by.title: How skin conditions look on dark skin (redness, rashes, rosacea, sunburn)

record.design: Survey of rosacea diagnosis by race
record.finding: 2.0% of patients with a rosacea diagnosis were Black. When Black patients attended with "other diseases of the skin", rosacea was the diagnosis for 2.2% against 8.3% of White patients; the authors suggest underdiagnosis in skin of colour.
record.note: Cannot separate lower rates from underdiagnosis.
